source_checks.finding: PGIM and Assembly announced a joint venture acquisition for AUD248m. The centre is described as a convenience and leisure-based neighbourhood destination, over 24,500 sqm, with Coles, TK Maxx, Event Cinemas, nine mini-majors and 78 specialty stores. This announcement alone does not establish settlement or ownership percentages.

Sales campaign reports 24,502 sqm GLA, 89 specialty stores and 926 parking spaces. Total trade area 208,850 residents (2024); main trade area 72,160, reference year not separately specified. Boundaries not supplied on page. CBRE acts on sale; this does not establish an ongoing leasing appointment.

Indexed public statement by JLL representative Rebecca Norton reports management appointment following Assembly and PGIM acquisition. Approximate 28,000 sqm description differs from earlier GLA disclosure. Exact appointment and settlement dates, holding entities and ownership split are not established.
Official centre contact page uses a JLL centre-management mailbox and confirms 52 Soldiers Parade, Edmondson Park NSW2174. Corroborates the public JLL management appointment statement.

Official leasing page offers a permanent leasing enquiry form and separately links casual mall leasing to Location X JLL. No unit inventory or commercial terms provided. Permanent exclusive agency appointment not specified.

Centre is opposite Edmondson Park station and bus stops, with a signed walking approach via Henderson Road and Sergeant Street. Three-hour free parking published with conditions; re-entry wording conflicts between 30 and 60 minutes. Accessible bays, pram bays and EV charging described.

FY2025 annual report printed page51 (PDF page53) reports Ed.Square Retail effective share100%, estimated total lettable area25.1 thousand sqm, occupancy96.5% FY25 and95.3% FY24. Historical Frasers interest predates2026 sale announcement. Estimated lettable area is not substituted for GLA.

Legacy property page identifies Frasers as developer owner operator, lists40,000 sqm on completion and900+ parking. Current transaction evidence supersedes ownership wording; completion area is not operating GLA.

2021 Census QuickStats for Edmondson Park SA2:12,080 people, median age 31, household size3.4, median weekly household income2562. This differs in concept from estimated resident population and equivalised household income already used by the tool.
Official retailer page describes fashion for men women and children, footwear handbags cosmetics and homewares. Shop AGMM02 Ground Floor. Supports a reviewed cross-category classification.

remaining_actions: Obtain the current leasing plan with available unit areas and pedestrian routes.
Confirm post-acquisition holding entities and the permanent leasing contact or agency mandate.
Request dated footfall and customer-origin evidence plus the trade-area boundary.
Reconcile marketing GLA against the latest tenancy schedule and asset-area definition.
